entities.name: Streak
entities.description: Fast wolf of Arlinn Kord's pack on Innistrad, named for a white line along his flank.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: Werewolf planeswalker who leads a wolf pack on Innistrad.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: Influential and imposing werewolf who commanded a new aggressive pack.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane where Streak and Arlinn live.

events.summary: Streak is the first to follow Arlinn's order to fan out and investigate.
events.quote: Streak was the first to follow

events.summary: Streak and the pack show allegiance to Tovolar, who commands them.
Streak, Boulder and Redtooth growl at Arlinn, supporting Tovolar.
events.quote: Streak, alongside Boulder and Redtooth , growled and bared his teeth at Arlinn

events.summary: Arlinn proves the stronger werewolf and Streak rejoins her side.

relations.quote: showed a disturbing allegiance to Tovolar
